summary: Document M36 Root schema and content version pins in the M1296 interoperability envelope.
rationale: M1296 node indices inherit meaning from a particular M36 schema and root content release; both lineage dimensions must be explicit.
verification: Require root_schema_version to match M36-ROOT standard_version.
Require root_genome_version to match M36-ROOT genome_version.
Keep M1296 standard version independent from both M36 version domains.
notes: Documents core interoperability contract 1.1.0. No graph runtime or Root Genome data is changed.
